description: One command of the document editor ribbon (redesign DE-1.2): a core TmToolbarButton that carries the ribbon's stable contract - data-command, data-testid and data-priority (the rank declared for the command in DocumentEditorBuiltInToolbar, as primary, secondary or overflowonly). It registers with the enclosing TmToolbar (Overflow=Menu): tm-toolbar.js measures whether it fits and the core "More" menu offers it when it does not; a toggle (Pressed / PressedState) is a menuitemcheckbox there. The label is always supplied - it is the accessible name, the tooltip and the "More" entry - and is visible only on a Large button (the primary calls to action: Link, Comment, Image, Table). A pointer press does not take focus off the document (PreserveFocus).

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: An accessible name that differs from Text; defaults to Text.

parameters.name: Command
parameters.description: The ribbon command name (data-command); also the key of the declared priority in DocumentEditorBuiltInToolbar.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables the button and its "More" entry.

parameters.name: KeepMenuOpen
parameters.description: The "More" entry keeps the menu open while the surface the command opens is shown.

parameters.name: Large
parameters.description: True renders the label next to the icon (the primary call to action); false is an icon button.

parameters.name: OnClick
parameters.description: Raised when the command is activated, from the bar or from "More".

parameters.name: PreserveFocus
parameters.description: A pointer press does not move focus off the document (the selection survives). Default true.

parameters.name: Pressed
parameters.description: A toggle's state; null is a plain button.

parameters.name: PressedState
parameters.description: A tri-state toggle as "true", "false" or "mixed"; wins over Pressed when set.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Overrides the priority declared for Command in the registry.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The label: accessible name, "More" entry, and the visible text of a Large button.

parameters.name: Tooltip
parameters.description: The tooltip; defaults to Text. A disabled command carries the reason here.
